# smart-chunker

> Split CommonMark and GFM Markdown into retrieval chunks along headings, tables and code fences under a token budget, with sentence overlap and line-range metadata Python package `trysac-smart-chunker`, import name `smart_chunker`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
